name: Hivemind
author: wolfknight299_unity
description: Alien Robots are invading earth and it's your job to get rid of the hivemind network that commands all of the robots. Unfortunately we have only developed one gun that is effective against the robots which you are equipped with currently but even then, it doesn't do much damage to the robots, especially against the bigger ones. To really stick it to them, you must infiltrate their bases, steal their weapons and use them against them. Defeat the Animus Collective, the robots that make up the hivemind network in order to weaken The Hivemind, destroy him and the threat he poses to the world. Disclaimer: For some reason the browser version of Hivemind is not of the same quality as the downloadable stand-alone version of the game. If you'd like to play that version you can download it here: https://mark-auman.itch.io/hivemind
